title: Wynonna Judd – The Hard Truth Tour
seo_title: Wynonna Judd: The Hard Truth Tour in Springfield, MO
description: Wynonna Judd performs a live country music concert on The Hard Truth Tour, featuring her voice and her personal new material, along with her history as one half of The Judds. It takes place Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO. Tickets are sold only through the official ticketing services, HammonsHall.com and MissouriStateTix.com.
